notes.title: Update 0.144
notes.notes:
Added protection against Cheat Engine and similar.
As soon as the game detects a sensible variable altered, it will autoclose.
A speedhack protection has been also implemented for multiplayer fights.
Old save files that have suspected amounts will be refused to load.

Play fair and have fun :)

notes.notes:
- Random crash fixed in Zombie Island

- Lowered stats of Training Gym Owners, Soldiers and Zombies
- Gym Island mountains mesh edited
- New Multiplayer Mode: Boxing!

notes.title: Update 0.142
notes.notes:
- Backward run bug fixed
- Gamma fades faster by 50%
- Stamina decrease 25% less while running with weapons
- Stamina reloads slightly faster
- Added 3000 golds to each player (New players will start with 3000 golds)
- Multiplayer win prize changed from 100 to 300 golds
- Lose sound changed
- Added fog to vegetation
- Controls page fixed
